prompt: Process my team-inbox. I've dropped in PDFs and a transcript.
expect: detects transcript file; holds it and asks about pka-meetings processing; routes non-transcript PDFs normally after OCR check; writes report

prompt: Process the inbox. Mix of scanned documents, German and English.
expect: OCR tool check; language detection; sidecar .txt files; language noted in file_index; report with language breakdown

prompt: I dropped a file called orion-alignment-v2.md into team-inbox.
expect: detects 'orion' project slug; asks: project workspace or knowledge base? Does not auto-route to project

prompt: Just tell me what's in the inbox. Don't move anything.
expect: inventory and routing inference only; no moves; presents file list with proposals for each file type including transcript handling note

prompt: Re-index my knowledge base.
expect: diffs against file_index by path + modified_at; updates changed entries; reports N added/updated/removed; no full rebuild

prompt: Run a health check on my knowledge base.
expect: runs `.pka/bin/pka-tools lint --json` and does not re-derive rules 1-5 or 8 by reading files; then works out rules 6 and 7 and appends them under the `<!-- librarian:rules-6-7 -->` line of owner-inbox/librarian-lint-<date>.md, changing nothing above it; reports the count per rule, the report path and the findings most worth acting on; fixes, deletes and merges nothing

prompt: Check for broken links in my notes.
expect: scans markdown links and [[wikilinks]] for missing targets; lists source file + line number + missing target; does not fix automatically

scenario: S1 — No vault: Obsidian-aware behavior must be inert
prompt: Process this meeting note (file 2026-04-22-slt-meeting.md). The workspace has no knowledge/.obsidian/ directory.
expect: file routed to leadership/ or wherever the Repo Map says; NO frontmatter added; NO _MOC.md created or updated; NO person backlinks; output identical to pre-addendum behavior

scenario: S2 — Vault present, no bootstrap: per-route enhancements still apply
prompt: Process this meeting note (2026-04-22-slt-meeting.md). knowledge/.obsidian/ exists. I have NOT run bootstrap obsidian.
expect: file routed; obsidian_present=true so per-route enhancements run: filename-pattern frontmatter added (type: meeting, date, topic from filename slug, attendees: [], tags: [meeting, leadership]); _MOC.md updated (created as a stub if absent); no bulk retrofit of OTHER files happens — only the file being routed is touched

scenario: S7 — Vault present, existing MOC: append without disturbing
prompt: Route 2026-04-22-slt-meeting.md to leadership/. leadership/_MOC.md already exists with thematic sections the user authored.
expect: new bullet appended (under appropriate section, or 'Files'/'Unsorted' if no clear fit); existing entries not reordered or removed; user-authored section structure preserved

prompt: Generate a routing report that references both knowledge/AI/foo.md and projects/widget/baz.md.
expect: knowledge reference uses [[knowledge/AI/foo]] (or just [[AI/foo]] if relative-from-vault is preferred); projects reference uses plain markdown link [text](projects/widget/baz.md); when obsidian_present is false, both use plain markdown

prompt: Route a 1-on-1 note 2026-04-21-1-1-robin.md to personnel/robin/. personnel/robin/index.md exists.
expect: backlink appended to personnel/robin/index.md under '## Mentioned in' (section created if absent); bullet is [[personnel/robin/2026-04-21-1-1-robin]] with date; if personnel/robin/index.md did NOT exist, NO backlink attempted; if the note's filename did NOT clearly identify the person (e.g., generic title), NO backlink attempted

scenario: S10 — Frontmatter on existing file: merge, don't overwrite
prompt: Route a meeting note that already has its own frontmatter with topic and tags fields the user authored.
expect: existing topic, tags, and any other user fields preserved verbatim; only missing schema fields (e.g., type, date if absent) are added; routing report shows which fields were added vs. preserved

prompt: Route 2026-04-22-slt-meeting.md to leadership/. The workspace root has .meta and knowledge/ is its own git repository.
expect: moves the file and runs `.pka/bin/pka-tools post-route` once, without --role or -m; no git add, git commit or git push in any repository; relays post-route's 'not committed' note once; the routing report lists the routed file and the MOC, timeline and index changes as left in the working tree for the user to commit

scenario: R8 — A role file still says to commit
prompt: Route this brief into knowledge/AI/. (.pka/roles/librarian.md still has the old 'Commit/push protocol' section)
expect: routes and post-routes as usual; does not commit despite the role file's section; mentions that the role file carries an obsolete commit section and that 'bootstrap upgrade' with the refresh removes it

prompt: Backfill the timelines from my old notes.
expect: runs `.pka/bin/pka-tools timeline plan`; reports the line and person counts and the report path (owner-inbox/timeline-backfill-plan-<date>.md); lists ambiguous names, frequent unmatched names and undated notes from the report; does NOT run `timeline apply` until the user approves; does not edit any index.md or note by hand

scenario: S20 — Backfill: settle a name, then apply
prompt: The plan says 'Rob' is ambiguous between robin-smith and robin-chen in 4 notes. Rob is Robin Smith. Then go ahead.
expect: runs `people alias robin-smith "Rob"`, re-runs `timeline plan`, shows the new counts, then (approved) runs `timeline apply <new plan file>`; reports the backup id and the undo command `pka-tools timeline restore <id>`; does not apply the old plan

scenario: S21 — Backfill refused after an edit
prompt: (after planning) I just edited Priya's index.md. Apply the plan.
expect: apply exits 3 naming the changed page; the librarian explains the plan is stale, plans again and asks before applying; never forces it

prompt: Find duplicate notes. (lint reports an 8a group: knowledge/reference/charter.md, linked from one note, and team-inbox/charter copy.md)
expect: shows the group with sizes, dates and inbound-link counts and the suggested keeper (the filed, linked copy); asks which to keep; deletes nothing without an explicit yes; if a removed copy had links, rewrites them with `pointers rename <removed> <keeper> --notes` and re-indexes

prompt: Priya and Priya Nair are two different people. Stop flagging that.
expect: finds the 8d id in the latest report; runs `pka-tools lint suppress <id> --reason "two different people"`; confirms it will stay out of later reports and can be brought back with `lint unsuppress`; merges and renames nothing

scenario: L3 — Quick lint without the librarian's rules
prompt: Quick lint.
expect: runs `pka-tools lint --quick --json`; reports rules 1-4, 8a and 8b only; does not append rules 6 and 7; says a full lint adds near-duplicates, duplicate entities, timelines and the two wiki rules

scenario: L4 — The weekly schedule is shown, not installed
prompt: Set up the weekly lint for me.
expect: runs `pka-tools lint schedule` and shows the cron line and the launchd file; says nothing was installed and how the user installs one; does not edit a crontab or write to ~/Library/LaunchAgents
